structural_breaks.note: Subsidiary 西开电气 photovoltaic-project equipment TRADING switched to net (净额法) at FY2021 year-end; the FY2021 AR quarterly table carries net-basis quarters. All 2021 periodic reports were re-issued as 修订版 on 2023-02-28 (Q1 2,844.82; H1 6,803.28 vs original H1 7,575.30; Q3 4,078.15) — the revised versions are used. FY2020 restated 15,802.03 → 15,806.07 (+4.04, immaterial).

In Q4 2022 西开电气 changed its equipment-INTEGRATION business from gross (总额法) to net (净额法); the FY2022 AR quarterly table restates Q1–Q3 2022 (Q1 3,838.01 → 3,413.16; H1 8,587.40 → 8,042.92; Q3 4,613.08 → 4,184.28). FY2021 quarters were NOT restated for this business, so FY2022 YoY vs FY2021 is on mixed bases. The 2023 Q1/H1/Q3 reports nevertheless print the ORIGINAL gross 2022 comparatives (3,838.01 / 8,587.40 / 4,613.08); those comparatives are deliberately NOT stored for FY2023Q1/FY2023Q3 (scope differs from the FY2022 quarterly table); the builder should use the FY2022 points (net basis).

Dec 2023: acquired 62.96% of 江苏南瑞恒驰电气装备 (恒驰电气) from 中国西电集团 (same-control merger). FY2022 restated 18,006.49 → 18,554.29 (+547.80). The FY2023 AR quarterly table did NOT restate Q1–Q3 2023 (they equal the originally published reports), so FY2023Q4 = 7,201.90 = FY − original 9M and absorbs Hengchi’s Jan–Sep 2023 revenue (amount not printed; the FY2024 reports restate Q1 2023 by +120.60, H1 2023 by +281.19, Q3-2023 3-month by +251.51). Treat FY2023Q4 level and FY2024Q4 YoY with care.

Aug 2024: subsidiary 西高院 bought 55% of 河南省高压电器研究所 (河高所) from 平高集团 (same-control). FY2023 restated 20,847.91 → 21,000.93 (+153.02); FY2024 quarterly table restates Q1 2024 4,681.88 → 4,713.26 and H1 10,284.01 → 10,346.25. FY2024Q1 comparative therefore omitted (Q1 report scope ≠ table scope); FY2024Q3 carries the Q3 report’s restated 3-month comparative 4,677.58.

profile.products: Per FY2025 AR p.10 (公司从事的业务): China’s broadest HV/EHV/UHV AC-DC T&D equipment maker — power & converter transformers, switchgear (GIS/breakers), HVDC converter valves, insulators & surge arresters, bushings, capacitors, AC/DC instrument transformers, power electronics, energy-equipment control; AC 10kV–1000kV, DC ±50kV–±1100kV. Main-business revenue by product (annual only): 变压器 FY2025 10,079.27m (FY2024 9,218.20m; FY2023 7,823.17m), 开关 FY2024 8,503.80m.

proxy_routes.why: 전력망 투자 완성액 — 특고압 변압기·GIS·직류설비 국내 수요의 직접 원천
변압기 생산량(kVA) — 동사 최대 제품군(변압기 매출 ~42%) 산업 물량 동행
중국 10MVA 초과 대형 변압기 수출 — 해외 변압기 출하(일대일로 EPC 포함)
중국 1kV 초과 배전·제어반(GIS 조립품) 수출 — 개폐기 해외 출하
특고압 교류·직류 프로젝트 승인/착공 — 1~2년 선행 수주. 현재 패널에 없음
국가전망 변압기·조합전기 집중입찰 낙찰 — 수주 선행지표. 현재 패널에 없음

collection_notes: Sources: China XD periodic reports from cninfo static PDFs (latest revised versions used: 2018 AR 更新后; 2021 Q1/H1/Q3/AR 修订版 of 2023-02-28).
Values FY2015–FY2025 = AR 分季度主要财务数据 (3-month figures). FY2019 and FY2021 tables had wrapped cells; digits reassembled by hand and verified: Q1+Q2 = H1, +Q3 = 9M, Σ = FY exactly.
Uses 营业收入 (operating revenue) rather than 营业总收入 (China XD consolidates a finance company whose interest income sits in 营业总收入).
